items.what: Apple Silicon에서 GPU 기반 최적화 기법(KV pruning, speculative decoding, quantization)이 CPU 환경에서 실제로 이식성이 낮음을 실증.
items.relation: 우리와 동일한 CPU-only 전제이며, GPU 최적화 기법이 CPU에서 성능 저하한다는 핵심 관찰은 H5(overlap zero-sum)과 관련. Prefill 중심 단일 요청 워크로드도 부분 일치.
items.gap: Apple Silicon은 고사양 ARM(M-series)이고 우리는 저사양 SBC이므로 메모리 대역폭·캐시·코어 수 차이 큼. 하지만 CPU-only 최적화 portability 결론은 직접 참고 가능.
hypothesis_notes: H5: CPU 코어가 4개뿐이라 통신 스레드와 GEMM이 경합, overlap이 zero-sum이 되는 구간이 존재한다
items.title: Evaluating the Applicability of LLM Inference Optimizations on Apple Silicon
items.abstract: Apple Silicon is among the most widely used platforms for local LLM inference, yet nearly all inference optimizations are designed and validated on server-class NVIDIA GPUs under batched serving workloads. Which optimizations retain their benefits when moved to Apple Silicon, and what determines their applicability? We evaluate four optimization families: KV-cache pruning, speculative decoding, ported GPU kernels, and post-training quantization. Experiments span four Apple machines under a common single-request decode workload, with matched RTX 4090 comparisons where possible. KV-cache pruning

items.what: 비디오 생성 모델에서 layer-head별 token merging 민감도를 offline 보정으로 학습, 동적 프로그래밍으로 최적 할당.
items.relation: KV cache 메모리 절감 방법이 H3과 같은 메모리 최적화 축이지만, token merging은 attention 정보 손실 기반의 다른 기법.
items.gap: 비디오 자동회귀 생성 특화이고, layer-head 민감도는 우리의 S≤4K에서 MLP 병목(H2) 분석과는 다른 문제.
hypothesis_notes: H3: 상위 절반 레이어의 KV를 xk에서 직접 산출하면 prefill FLOPs가 ~48 % 감소
items.title: Offline Makes Online Better: Calibrated Cache Compression for Video Generation
items.abstract: Token merging is an effective approach to reducing KV-cache memory consumption in autoregressive video generation by clustering temporally redundant tokens and retaining only a small set of representatives. Existing methods, however, typically apply a uniform merging ratio across all attention layers and heads. We observe that different layers and heads exhibit substantially different yet jointly correlated sensitivities to token merging, and that these sensitivity patterns remain consistent across prompts. Based on this observation, we introduce CALM, a Calibrated Allocation for Layer-Head Me

items.what: MoE 모델의 KV cache 압축 시 라우팅 분포 민감도를 Fisher information으로 정량화하여 강건한 압축 달성.
items.relation: KV cache 최적화라는 H3과 같은 축이지만, MoE 라우팅 문제는 dense Transformer에 없고 극단적 long-context(10% 유지율) 가정.
items.gap: MoE 특이성으로 우리의 0.5~4K prefill에서 직접 적용 어려움. 라우팅 변화가 주요 병목이 아닐 가능성.
hypothesis_notes: H3: 상위 절반 레이어의 KV를 xk에서 직접 산출하면 prefill FLOPs가 ~48 % 감소
items.title: MoEZip: Routing-Aware KV Cache Compression for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
items.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models scale model capacity efficiently by activating a small subset of parameters per token. However, in long-context inference, memory remains a major bottleneck because the KV cache grows linearly with sequence length. Existing KV cache compression methods reduce this cost for dense transformers, but overlook a problem specific to MoE: KV eviction can change which experts are selected during answer generation, degrading the generation quality. all.what: 스트리밍 비디오에서 idle 시 제한 context로 prefill, query 시 query-aware context로 KV 선택 재계산하여 prefill FLOP 20% 감소.
all.relation: KV recomputation과 prefill 비용 감소라는 점에서 H3의 KV 산출 아이디어와 개념적 유사성 있음.
all.gap: 비디오 도메인이고, recomputation이 query 시점에 query-aware하게 이루어지는데, 우리는 prefill 시점에 KV를 다른 구조로 산출하려는 설계. Context mismatch도 video-specific.
hypothesis_notes: H3: 상위 절반 레이어의 KV를 xk에서 직접 산출하면 prefill FLOPs가 ~48 % 감소
all.title: Cache Locally, Recompute Selectively for Streaming Video Understanding
all.abstract: Streaming video understanding (SVU) requires video-LLMs to process incoming video continuously while answering user queries with low latency. Recent methods reduce query-time cost by prefilling frames into KV caches during idle time and reusing the cached KVs at query time. To bound per-frame computation over unbounded video streams, these methods restrict the context available during prefill. This creates a fundamental context mismatch: the restricted context may omit information needed to properly contextualize video tokens, yet, still contain information irrelevant to the eventual query, wh

all.what: GPU/CPU 메모리를 통합 논리 주소로 관리하는 KV cache 시스템. Sparse attention 지원, 병렬 LRU 퇴출 정책.
all.relation: KV cache 메모리 계층 최적화, CPU 메모리 활용이 H1(통신 병목)과 메모리 관리 축에서 관련. 분산 저장 시 통신도 부분 관련.
all.gap: GPU 주도의 GPU/CPU 이기종이고, speculative decoding·TP/DP 병렬화 결합으로 우리의 CPU-only/1GbE/단순 병렬과는 맥락 차이. Sparse attention도 우리 prefill과 직접 관련 약함.
hypothesis_notes: H1: prefill 시간의 25~45 %가 통신+barrier 대기이며, 그중 대기(straggler) 가 순수 전송보다 크다
all.title: UlaCache: Unified Logical Addressing for Sparse LLM Serving
all.abstract: Long contexts increase the memory cost of the key-value (KV) cache in large language model (LLM) inference. Sparse attention reduces attention computation and memory traffic by selecting historical tokens, but the retained KV cache must remain available for later decoding steps. We present UlaCache, a KV cache management system built around a unified logical address space spanning GPU KV pools and optional CPU memory. Stable logical references let the inference engine allocate and select KV independently of physical placement. Common allocation and sparse-access interfaces support data-paralle

all.what: GPU-NPU 이종 가속기에서 prefill은 GPU, decode는 NPU에 매핑하고 양자 간 KV cache를 RDMA로 이동.
all.relation: Phase disaggregation 구조는 공통이지만 GPU/NPU 고성능 가속기 기반이므로 우리의 CPU-only 환경과 전제가 완전히 다름.
all.gap: GPU/NPU와 RDMA 통신 가정인데 우리는 CPU-only/1GbE. KV 이동 메커니즘 자체가 고성능 인터커넥트 기반.
all.title: HAWK: Heterogeneity-Aware KV Cache Transfer for Efficient GPU-NPU Phase-Disaggregated LLM Inference
all.abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference exhibits distinct computational characteristics across its two phases: prefill is compute-intensive, whereas decode is more memory-bound. As a result, AI accelerators achieve varying levels of efficiency across the two phases. GPUs are well suited to prefill, but are often underutilized during decode. By contrast, NPUs can utilize their compute resources more effectively during decode. Motivated by this observation, we explore a heterogeneous architecture that integrates GPUs and NPUs, mapping prefill to GPUs and decode to NPUs to achieve high performance a

all.what: 모바일-서버 분산 추론에서 헤드 네트워크를 연합학습과 지식증류로 학습하여 데이터 프라이버시 보장하며 통신 감소.
all.relation: Split computing이 부분 관련이지만 초록의 핵심은 프라이버시 보존 학습 기법이며, prefill 연산 최적화가 아님.
all.gap: 전체 네트워크를 두 부분으로 분할하는 구조인데, 우리는 prefill 연산 자체의 FLOP 감소를 목표로 함.
all.title: Unsupervised Head Network Personalization for Split Computing via Federated Learning
all.abstract: Split Computing (SC) is a distributed inference method designed for balancing computational load and reducing latency by partitioning a neural network into head and tail networks and deploying them across both a mobile device and a server, respectively. Due to the limited bandwidth and computational power of mobile devices, the head network is often replaced with a neural network that requires lower computational and communication resources. However, it is challenging to prepare a sufficient quantity and quality of labeled data on the mobile device side for training the replacement head networ

all.what: LLM 서빙에서 SSD 오프로드 시 SSD 수명 단축 문제를 attention type별 admission policy로 완화.
all.relation: 메모리 계층 최적화라는 점에서 메모리 병목과 관련이 있지만, SSD 내구성 관리는 prefill 최적화와 무관.
all.gap: 극단적 장기 서빙(multi-round conversation)에서 SSD 수명 문제인데, 우리는 0.5~4K prefill 단순 요청. SSD I/O와 1GbE 네트워크는 다른 계층.
all.title: Gandalf: Flash Shall Not Die! Increasing Flash Storage Lifetime for KV Cache Offloading in LLM Serving
all.abstract: KV caching reduces the serving cost of large language models (LLMs), but the growing KV cache footprint is increasingly exceeds GPU and host-memory capacity. Therefore, people use SSD to expand the KV cache storage capacity with high I/O bandwidth. However, in production LLM workload, such as multi-round conversation and LLM agents, the total amount of KV cache writes significantly exceeds SSD capacity, shortening SSD lifetime from years to months.
